newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina to question many customs staff - papers.
newsitem.headline: Argentina to question many customs staff - papers.

text.p: Argentina's customs service will question 1,000 of its workers -- 25 percent of its total staff -- as part of a massive smuggling investigation, local media reported Friday.
Treasury prosecutor Rodolfo Diaz told reporters that investigators will question the workers over 207 administrative irregularities since 1993.

President Carlos Menem launched a major probe into the customs service in October and the government said it thought that a smuggling ring inside the service had brought $10 billion worth of goods into the country off the books over four years.

"These are not isolated incidents nor were they merely the individual behaviour of a few people. It was clear from our investigation that there was an organized system," Diaz said, quoted by La Nacion.
Former customs chief Gustavo Parino was arrested last week after a judge ordered his detention as part of the smuggling probe.
